name: ELVA - Premium Apartment Hotel
beschreibung:
Situated in the heart of scenic Neustift in the Stubai valley, ELVA blends state-of-the-art alpine design with exclusive living comfort. The spacious luxury residences feature fine natural materials, private saunas, and panoramic windows facing the Stubai Alps.

The nearby Stubai Glacier and the Elfer lifts deliver outstanding year-round opportunities for winter sports enthusiasts and mountain hikers.
kurzbeschreibung: ELVA - Premium Apartment Hotel in Neustift in the Stubaital offers luxury designer apartments with private spa amenities and glacier views.
